# Lexington Gays
> Lexington's weekly LGBTQ+ event guide and community directory.

## Key pages
- /: This week's curated LGBTQ+ events with day-by-day schedule
- /blog/: Long-form guides to gay Lexington, venues, neighborhoods, travel
- /directory.html: Searchable directory of LGBTQ+ owned and friendly businesses

## Guides (long-form, citable)
- /blog/moving-to-lexington-lgbtq.html: Moving to Lexington as an LGBTQ+ person: neighborhoods, safety, community
- /blog/gay-bars-lexington.html: Gay bars in Lexington: The Bar Complex, Crossings, and where to go out
- /blog/gay-lexington-travel-guide.html: Gay Lexington travel guide: where to stay, eat, and play
- /blog/lexington-vs-louisville-gay-scene.html: Lexington vs Louisville: comparing the two Kentucky gay scenes
- /blog/new-to-lexington-queer-starter-pack.html: New to Lexington queer starter pack
- /blog/date-night-queer-lexington.html: Queer date-night ideas in Lexington
- /blog/lgbtq-sports-lexington.html: LGBTQ+ sports and rec leagues in Lexington

## About
Lexington Gays is a volunteer-run community resource. We publish a curated weekly
LGBTQ+ event guide for Lexington, KY along with travel and lifestyle
coverage of queer life in Lexington. No commercial intent. Coverage area is the
Lexington metro.
